headline.purpose: Page-level hero titles. Used once per major view.

title.purpose: Section headers, card titles, dialog headers.

body.purpose: Turn content, descriptions, settings prose. Default reading size.

label.purpose: Role chips, metadata, timestamps, supporting context. Scanning, not reading.

label-upper.purpose: Section eyebrows — sparse, uppercase, tracked. One per section.

shadows.name: hero-lift
shadows.purpose: Applied only to the hero discussion preview card to mark it as a floating artifact.

motion.name: fade-in-up
motion.purpose: Turn bubble entrance. Applied via .animate-fade-in. The single authored motion; not generalized.

motion.name: state-shift
motion.purpose: Border color, background, opacity changes on hover/active states.

motion.name: scale-active
motion.purpose: Tactile micro-response on interactive cards and buttons.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single violet CTA — 'Start a roundtable', 'New Meeting', 'Start Roundtable →'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #7c6af7; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c6af7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions — 'Manage personas', 'Edit', ghost nav links.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #6b6b80; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid #2e2e3e; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms, color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #ffffff; border-color: rgba(124, 106, 247, 0.5); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c6af7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Turn Bubble
components.description: A speaker's message in the discussion feed. The persona color is applied to the left border and avatar ring.
components.html:
SC
Sarah Chen CTO #1
The competitive data is clear — if we wait another quarter, we're playing catch-up.
components.css: .ds-turn { display: flex; gap: 12px; animation: ds-fade-in-up 220ms ease-out both; } @keyframes ds-fade-in-up { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-turn { animation: none; } } .ds-turn-avatar-wrap { flex-shrink: 0; padding-top: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--persona) 25%, transparent); } .ds-turn-avatar { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9999px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--persona); color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-turn-body { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-turn-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-turn-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #ffffff; } .ds-turn-role { font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--persona) 13%, transparent); color: var(--persona); } .ds-turn-index { font-size: 0.75rem; margin-left: auto; color: #6b6b80; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-turn-bubble { background: #22222e; color: #e8e8f0; border-radius: 16px; border-top-left-radius: 0; padding: 12px 16px; border-left: 3px solid var(--persona); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; }

components.name: Persona Card
components.description: Card showing a persona's name, role, background, and expertise chips on the Personas list.
components.html:
SC

Sarah Chen

CTO

Pragmatic technologist with 15 years scaling infrastructure at Series B–D companies.

Cloud Architecture Team Scaling Security
components.css: .ds-persona-card { background: #1a1a24; border: 1px solid #2e2e3e; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start; transition: border-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-persona-card:hover { border-color: rgba(124, 106, 247, 0.5); } .ds-persona-card:active { transform: scale(0.99); } .ds-persona-avatar { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #9333ea; color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-persona-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-persona-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-persona-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: #ffffff; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-persona-role { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #7c6af7; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-persona-action { font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #2e2e3e; border-radius: 6px; color: #6b6b80; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-persona-action:hover { border-color: rgba(124, 106, 247, 0.5); } .ds-persona-bio { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6b6b80; margin-top: 8px; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } .ds-persona-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; margin-top: 12px; } .ds-chip { font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #22222e; color: #6b6b80; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input used in meeting setup and persona forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #6b6b80; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; background: #22222e; border: 1px solid #2e2e3e; border-radius: 8px; color: #e8e8f0; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b6b80; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c6af7; outline-offset: 0; border-color: transparent; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Meeting status indicator: Ready / Running / Completed / Error.
components.html: Ready Running Completed Error
components.css: .ds-status { font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-status--ready { color: #9ca3af; background: rgba(156,163,175,0.1); } .ds-status--running { color: #10b981; background: rgba(16,185,129,0.1); } .ds-status--completed { color: #7c6af7; background: rgba(124,106,247,0.1); } .ds-status--error { color: #ef4444; background: rgba(239,68,68,0.1); }

components.css: .ds-nav { border-bottom: 1px solid #2e2e3e; background: #1a1a24; } .ds-nav-inner { max-width: 1152px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-nav-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #e8e8f0; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; } .ds-nav-link { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6b6b80; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview:
Roundtable Knights lives in a digital council chamber: a space of austere authority where deliberation happens under low, purposeful light. The aesthetic is architectural rather than decorative — deep void backgrounds recede so the personas and their arguments can command attention. The single violet accent is the chamber's one source of warmth, used with discipline; when it appears, it signals action or identity.

Density is moderate-high. This is a working tool, not a dashboard. Text is the product — turns, arguments, dissents — and the interface is designed to get out of its way. Cards have presence without mass. Borders are structural, not ornamental. Spacing is precise: tight groupings within components, generous gutters between them.

The light theme inverts the material — the chamber walls become pale and clean — but the structural logic is identical. Every spacing and color decision that works in dark reads clearly in light. No element relies on darkness to function.
keyCharacteristics: Void-dark base with a single violet accent held in careful reserve
Persona-color system: each participant gets a unique hue that tints their avatar ring, bubble border, and role chip
Turn bubbles use a 3px left-border in the speaker's persona color — the visual signature of multi-voice structure
Moderate-high density; legibility at speed is the primary layout concern
Flat surfaces with tonal layering; elevation through background shifts, not shadows
All motion is purposeful and brief: fade-in-up entrance at 220ms ease-out only

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Violet is used at ≤15% of any screen's visual area. Its rarity makes it a reliable signal. Every additional use dilutes the effect; remove uses before adding them.

rules.name: The Persona Color Contract
rules.body: Each persona is assigned a color keyed on their UUID. That color owns their avatar, bubble border, and role chip. It is never borrowed for global UI elements.

rules.name: The No-Scale-Jump Rule
rules.body: There is no intermediate step between Title (1.125rem) and Headline (2.5rem). The gap is intentional; the two levels must not blur.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The shadow-2xl on the hero preview is a deliberate feature exception — it marks the preview as a contained artifact, not a page section. Do not generalize it.

dos: Do use the 3-step tonal ladder (Void → Chamber → Chamber Raised) to communicate depth.
Do assign persona colors from the deterministic avatar utility for every persona mention.
Do hold Violet in reserve for primary CTA, active/selected states, focus rings, and accent links only.
Do use rounded-xl rounded-tl-none for primary turn bubbles.
Do uppercase section eyebrows with tracking-widest in Counsel color — one per section only.
Do use text-balance on multi-line headings.
donts: Don't introduce a shadow on cards, inputs, or list rows.
Don't use a border-left wider than 3px on turn bubbles.
Don't use monospace fonts outside of inline code in turn content.
Don't reuse status colors (green, amber, red) for non-status purposes.
Don't add section eyebrow numbering unless sequence carries navigation meaning.
